<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
    <title>Agentry &mdash; runs</title>
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="/styles.css" />
    <style>
      body {
        margin: 0;
        font: 14px/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif;
        color: #1f2328;
      }
      .card > h2:first-child {
        margin-top: 0;
      }
      @media (max-width: 600px) {
        .card { padding: 8px; }
      }
    </style>
  </head>
  <body class="light">
    <!-- The list is filled in by the script below -->
    <header id="top">
      <h1>Runs</h1>
      <nav>
        <a href="/" class="active">Overview</a>
        <a href="/runs?status=running" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Running</a>
      </nav>
    </header>
    <main>
      <form action="/api/runs" method="post">
        <label for="prompt">Prompt</label>
        <textarea id="prompt" name="prompt" rows="4" required></textarea>
        <input type="checkbox" name="worktree" checked disabled />
        <button type="submit">Start</button>
      </form>
      <ul id="runs"></ul>
      <img src="/logo.svg" alt="Agentry logo" width="32" height="32" />
    </main>
    <script type="module">
      const list = document.getElementById('runs');
      const res = await fetch('/api/runs?limit=20');
      const { items } = await res.json();
      for (const run of items) {
        const li = document.createElement('li');
        li.textContent = `${run.title} (${run.status})`;
        list.append(li);
      }
      if (items.length === 0 || !res.ok) {
        list.innerHTML = '<li class="empty">No runs yet</li>';
      }
    </script>
  </body>
</html>
